sections: 1. What DISL still lacks for this type

items.reason: The pixels of an image are the host's to draw; the description states where a node's content goes.

hostCode.behaviour: A node added as a child or a sibling is created at once under a name read off the siblings it joins, then its text is edited in place.
The central topic is centred on the origin, its first-level branches split to its right and left as their POSITION says or alternately, each list of siblings a column centred on its parent.
